text:
Alex: Heads up — canary started showing a 2.5x p95 bump on embeddings after the 12:05 deploy. DeployBot flagged it.
DeployBot: [automated] Canary telemetry: embeddings.p95 > threshold. Initiating safety hold and routing to fallback model v3.6.0. Requesting manual review by SRE.
Priya: Looking into it now. KV cache misses spiking across the canary hosts, also a handful of 502s from the tokenizer service.
Jordan: @Priya can you paste a quick trace or a metric snapshot? Any config toggles in the 3.6.1 build?
Priya: Quick metric: ```curl -s http://metrics.internal/kvcache | jq '.misses.last60'``` -> 17842 (baseline ~120). There's a new kernel flag in the 3.6.1 image: `--kvcache-optim`.
Marta: If we roll back, we should prepare a short customer note for dedicated pools. Some customers on reserved capacity might notice higher latencies during the event.
Alex: Recommendation: manual rollback to v3.6.0 in prod now. Plan: rollback canary -> verify -> roll back remainder. Command I want to run: `/deploy rollback --to v3.6.0 --scope canary,eu,usw2 --note "kvcache miss regression"`
SRE-Shift: I'll execute the rollback in ~2m and monitor. I'll also drain the affected hosts gracefully to preserve KV state.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated by SRE-Shift. Starting traffic drain, draining kvcache clients, and switching routes back to v3.6.0. Estimated completion ~4m.
Jordan: After rollback completes, let's pin v3.6.0 for 24h and open a ticket for a scoped revert/patch. Also add `--kvcache-optim` to the regression checklist.
Priya: Metrics updating — p95 trending down on canary: 310ms -> 120ms. 502 count decreasing. :tada:
Alex: Nice. @Marta please draft the outgoing note for dedicated customers. Keep it factual and short: time window, rollback action, no data loss, follow-up RCA.
Marta: Drafted: "We observed increased latency on embeddings between 12:05–12:11 UTC after a deployment. We rolled back the release to v3.6.0 and traffic has been restored. No data loss. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with an RCA."
Priya: Created INF-4872 for runtime team, assigned to @Jordan and runtime. Added logs and a small repro for the kvcache flag.
Jordan: Also updating release notes: revert the note about `--kvcache-optim` landing in 3.6.1. Mark 3.6.1 as retracted until we validate.
Alex: OK — leaving a 24h pin on v3.6.0. If anyone plans a reattempt, coordinate here and run full kvcache regression tests first. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Rollback completed. Traffic restored to v3.6.0 everywhere. All canaries reporting stable telemetry.
SRE-Shift: Post-rollback check: running a 30m telemetry watch and will escalate if anything else pops.
Alex: Thanks team. We'll collect traces and schedule a short postmortem tomorrow.
